item.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets, allowing digital asset offerings up to $75M annually without full securities registration.
U.S. Treasury proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rules requiring issuers to conduct KYC checks comparable to traditional financial firms.
Coldcard hardware wallet bug enabled theft of over $100M in Bitcoin from ~7,300 addresses in multiple coordinated attack waves.
U.S. Senate departs for August recess without a vote on the CLARITY Act digital asset market-structure bill.
CFTC chair directs staff to draft crypto market structure rules in the event Congress fails to pass the CLARITY Act.
BlackRock tokenizes $311B in European money market funds, enabling 24/7 on-chain transfers via JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain platform.
JPMorgan will accept BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust shares as loan collateral in an expansion of its crypto lending program.
MiCA enforcement displaced over 1,700 unlicensed platforms from the EU, with regulators warning of a resulting rise in crypto scams.
EU opens public consultation on MiCA 2.0 revisions through August 31, including potential changes to the stablecoin interest ban.
BTCPay Server vulnerability allowed attackers to drain merchant Lightning nodes by exploiting exposed credential configurations.
US Bancorp has resumed Bitcoin custody services, adding support for spot Bitcoin ETF shares for institutional clients.
SafePal disclosed a data breach exposing order records for approximately 40,000 customers from purchases made between 2025 and 2026.
